title: Coroner's inquest called into death of woman shot by Hamilton police
subtitle: Thirty-year-old died on Oct. 20, 2018, when she was shot by police inside downtown Hamilton apartment
article: More than six years after Robyn Garlow was fatally shot by Hamilton police in a downtown apartment, the coroner's office has called an inquest into her death.
Dr. Karen Schiff, regional supervising coroner, announced an inquest into Garlow's death Tuesday. The inquest is mandatory because she died in an interaction with police.
The fatal shooting early on Oct. 20, 2018, was investigated by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU), which concluded there were no grounds to charge the police officer who shot the 30-year-old.
According to the SIU report, police were called to the two-storey apartment building at King and Wellington streets around 1 a.m. A neighbour reported a woman with a knife was "not of sound mind."

A man in the apartment with Garlow, who was armed with a hammer, had been cut, the report said. When police arrived, the injured man led two officers upstairs where they found Garlow standing on a bed with a knife in her hand.

She refused police orders to drop the knife and began cutting her throat, the SIU report concluded. One officer attempted to use a Taser to stop her from hurting herself, but two attempts did not work.

According to the SIU, that's when she held the knife over her head, screamed and lunged at the officers. The other officer pointed his handgun at her and told her to drop the knife; when she continued to move toward the officers, he pulled the trigger four times and two bullets struck her.
The officers attempted CPR while they waited for an ambulance. Garlow was pronounced dead in hospital at 2 a.m.
The SIU found less than 30 seconds passed between when the officers entered the apartment and the shooting.

"I accept that the (subject officer) genuinely and reasonably believed that shooting the complainant was necessary to protect him and his partner from loss of life or grievous bodily harm," SIU director Joseph Martino said in the report. He concluded the shooting was justified.
Details on the inquest into Garlow's death, including when it will take place, will be announced at a later date.

Coroner's inquests examine the circumstances of a person's death and the jury reaches a verdict on the person's cause and manner of death. Juries can also make recommendations to help prevent similar deaths in the future. Inquests do not determine criminality or liability.

The length of time before an inquest is called varies. It depend on the complexity of investigations, if there are other related investigations, availability of counsel and witnesses, inquest length and other factors.
All jury matters were suspended during the pandemic, which resulted in a backlog of cases.
